note: The driftwood staff (C2, approved October 27, 2026; docs/future/16-the-sea-cave.md weapons: the first weapon, one-handed in the right hand, the lantern hand never free). Matt's two staves from one file, split and cut down by tools/assets/build-models.mjs (models.json part) into two looks of the one staff; each island draws one from its seed (src/world/kit/staff.js), so nothing is saved for it. Shown on tool pages only (tools/walker-strip.html) until the move arena (H0); not in the game's kit or the arch yet. lengthM: the staff's length in the world (the models are baked 1.0 m long; this scales them). gripM: how far up from its foot the right hand holds it. hold: carried on the bone like a carrier (src/world/figure/carry.js): at, the grip in rest model meters (the palm, a little below and inside the wrist); turnDeg, the staff's pitch, yaw and roll on the hand, so it stands near upright in the hanging hand, leaning a little forward, and follows the swings; upright, walking or standing it stays this share of the way to upright (leaning tiltDeg forward) as the arm swings, so it reads as a walking staff; while a swing plays it moves with the hand alone.
